replies.body:
KD doesn't really reflect how well you PvP.

Typically, any KD that is over 1.0 is considered "good".

1.0 is approximately average.

Also, you say in the title "Whats your K/D", so do you want to know our KD's, or do you just want to know if your KD is good?
